en: To get money by working; or to get something you deserve by your efforts.
ex: She earns a good salary as a nurse.
她當護理師，薪水不錯。

en: A piece of jewelry worn on or in the ear.
ex: She wore a pair of pearl earrings to the party.
她戴著一副珍珠耳環去參加派對。

en: A state of being comfortable without problems; or to make something less painful or difficult; or the ability to do something without trouble.
ex: The medicine eased the pain in her back.
這藥減輕了她背部的疼痛。

en: Located in or coming from the east part of a place; or relating to the East.
ex: The eastern part of the island has beautiful mountains.
島的東部有美麗的山脈。

en: The outside part of something where it ends; or the sharp side of a knife; or an advantage over others.
ex: He stood at the edge of the cliff and looked down.
他站在懸崖邊往下看。

en: A particular form of a book, newspaper or program that is published at one time; or all the copies printed at one time.
ex: This is the latest edition of the dictionary.
這是這本字典的最新版本。

en: The process of teaching or learning in a school or college; or the knowledge you get from this.
ex: Education is very important for children's future.
教育對孩子的未來非常重要。

en: A change that is the result of something; or an influence on someone or something; or to make something happen.
ex: The medicine had a good effect on her cold.
這藥對她的感冒很有效。

en: The use of physical or mental energy to do something; or an attempt.
ex: She made a big effort to learn English.
她很努力地學習英語。

en: Working by electricity; or relating to electricity.
ex: She bought an electric fan for the hot summer.
她為炎熱的夏天買了一台電風扇。

en: Relating to electricity or using electricity.
ex: The shop sells many electrical appliances.
這家店販售許多電器用品。

en: A strong feeling such as love, anger or fear.
ex: She couldn't hide her emotions when she heard the news.
她聽到消息時無法掩飾自己的情緒。

en: To give special importance to something; or to say something strongly so people notice it.
ex: The teacher emphasized the importance of reading every day.
老師強調每天閱讀的重要性。

en: To give someone a job and pay them; or to use something; or the state of having a job.
ex: The company employs more than two hundred people.
這家公司僱用了兩百多人。

en: A person who is paid to work for a company or another person.
ex: Every employee must wear a name badge.
每位員工都必須戴名牌。

en: A person or company that pays people to work for them.
ex: The factory is the largest employer in the town.
這間工廠是鎮上最大的雇主。

en: Having nothing inside; or without people; or to take everything out of something.
ex: The refrigerator was empty, so we went shopping.
冰箱空了，所以我們去買東西。

en: To give someone confidence or hope; or to persuade someone to do something; or to support something.
ex: My teacher encouraged me to join the speech contest.
我的老師鼓勵我參加演講比賽。

en: A person who is against you and wants to harm you; or the army of a country that you are fighting.
ex: The two countries were enemies for many years.
這兩個國家多年來一直是敵人。

en: The ability to be active without getting tired; or the power that is used to make machines work.
ex: Children are full of energy and love to run around.
孩子們精力充沛，愛到處跑。

en: Whole or complete; including all parts.
ex: She spent the entire day reading in the garden.
她整天都在花園裡看書。

en: Relating to the natural world or the conditions around people, animals and plants.
ex: Environmental pollution is a serious global problem.
環境汙染是一個嚴重的全球問題。

en: The same in size, amount or value; or treating everyone in the same way; or to be the same as something.
ex: Everyone should have an equal chance to learn.
每個人都應該有平等的學習機會。

en: More than usual; or in particular; or very much so.
ex: I love fruit, especially apples and oranges.
我愛吃水果，尤其是蘋果和橘子。

en: The evening or day before an important day or event.
ex: We went to a party on New Year's Eve.
我們在除夕夜去參加派對。

en: Very bad and harmful; or morally wrong; or wickedness.
ex: In the fairy tale, an evil witch cast a spell on the princess.
在童話故事裡，一個邪惡的女巫對公主施了咒。

en: Completely correct in every detail; or exactly the same as something.
ex: What is the exact time now?
現在確切的時間是幾點？

en: A formal test of knowledge or ability; or a careful look at someone or something.
ex: She studied hard for the English exam.
她為英語考試認真念書。

en: To make someone feel very happy and interested; or to cause a strong feeling.
ex: The news of the trip excited all the children.
旅行的消息讓所有的孩子都很興奮。

en: To forgive someone for doing something wrong; or to let someone off a duty; or a reason given for a mistake.
ex: Excuse me, could you tell me the way to the station?
請問，你能告訴我去車站的路嗎？

en: To be real or alive; or to be present in a place; or to continue to live.
ex: Dinosaurs existed millions of years ago.
恐龍在數百萬年前就存在了。

en: The money you spend on something; or a cost or a loss; or something at someone's cost.
ex: The company paid for all of our travel expenses.
公司支付了我們所有的旅費。

en: A person who has special knowledge or skill in something; or very skilled.
ex: She is an expert in the history of art.
她是藝術史方面的專家。

en: To show a feeling or idea in words or actions; or fast; or a fast train or delivery.
ex: She expressed her thanks to the teacher for the help.
她向老師表達謝意，感謝他的幫助。

en: The look on someone's face that shows how they feel; or a word or phrase; or the act of showing feelings in words.
ex: The expression on her face showed that she was surprised.
她臉上的表情顯示她很驚訝。

en: The line of short hair above your eye.
ex: He raised one eyebrow in surprise.
他驚訝地揚起一邊眉毛。

en: One of the things that affect a result; or a number that divides another number exactly.
ex: Hard work is a key factor in her success.
努力工作是她成功的關鍵因素。

en: The fact of not succeeding; or someone or something that does not succeed; or the stopping of a machine.
ex: The first attempt ended in failure, but she tried again.
第一次嘗試以失敗告終，但她又試了一次。

en: Treating everyone equally and reasonably; or light-colored; or an outdoor event with games and rides.
ex: It is not fair that he gets more than the others.
他比其他人得到更多，這不公平。

en: Not true or correct; or not real; or made to look like something real.
ex: The news report turned out to be false.
那篇新聞報導後來被證實是假的。
